data.current_summary: Convert HTML or a URL to PDF (PDFShift v3 compatible)
data.current_description: Renders the HTML document or public URL in `source` with Chromium and returns the PDF. Nothing is stored. Retrying is safe: a render has no side effects and nothing is stored, so a repeated request never creates a duplicate. Retry 408, 429 and 503 with an increasing wait (for example 2, 4 and 8 seconds); do not retry other 4xx errors.
data.description_suggestion: Renders an HTML document or public URL to PDF using Chromium. Accepts HTML content or a URL in the `source` parameter. Returns the rendered PDF as binary data. Processing occurs on servers in Saudi Arabia (Oracle Cloud, me-jeddah-1); content is never stored or transmitted outside the Kingdom. Retrying is safe as renders have no side effects. Retry 408, 429, and 503 errors with exponential backoff (e.g., 2, 4, 8 seconds); do not retry other 4xx errors. Subject to monthly render quota limits reported in X-Quota-* response headers.
